title: hieracium carolinianum f. virescens
intro: Hieracium carolinianum f. virescens, commonly known as Carolina hawkweed, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family that is native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, it is used to treat digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory issues, with actions such as astringency, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant effects. The bioactive constituents of Carolina hawkweed include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
